card.title: One Philadelphia Police Officer Killed, Another Shot 12 Times in Ambush Attack
card.description: Two officers responding to a call were shot multiple times as they reached the scene. Officials said they took “significant fire.”

image.alt: As the two officers were taken to the hospital, police and members of the SWAT team were sent to the scene.
